game.name: Rec Room
game.rules:
**ALL RUNS REQUIRE VIDEO EVIDENCE**
If you remove the video evidence of your run after it has been verified, we reserve the right to remove the run because it no longer meets leaderboard requirements. If this occurs, you will need to resubmit your run to obtain credit.

**ALL POVs AND WORLD SCALE% ARE NEEDED FOR TOP RUNS**

On leaderboards with less than 25 runs, the top 3 runs must show their SteamVR world scale percentage before or after a run (world scale is not allowed and should remain at 100% for ANY run). On leaderboards with 25 runs or more, the requirement is extended to top 5. If there’s a category that has less than 5 runs world scale is not require to be shown. In multiplayer runs, this means that all POVs must be submitted unless the category falls under the less than 5 runs. This only applies to runs done on PCVR after the date of Nov 16th 2023. A bit of an add on but throttling behaviour will also not be allowed for any runs. This only applies for index players but when showing world scale if you scroll down a bit more it'll show throttling behaviour which should not be activated during runs.

Click the results page on the scoreboard to see your final time.
In a co-op run, if different players see different result times on the leaderboard, we will take the lower time.

- No players may leave or join at ANY point during the run for ANY reason
- Joking around during a run and trying to make a run longer than it needs to be is not allowed. A speedrun should be an attempt to go as fast as you can.
- You are not allowed to abuse the size of your playspace to move faster in a run, though you ARE allowed to glitchwalk (leaning and in-game turning). Usually if you take a step here and there (around like once or MAYBE twice in each act) it's fine but if you're constantly walking and you rely on it or are performing a trick that only can be done taking a step or can only be done on large playspaces, thats when it crosses the line.
- Do not use system recalibration during runs.
Examples: OVR Advanced Settings, PSVR recalibration, Quest recalibration, and others of the sort to get through walls or move faster is prohibited.
- Your height cannot be lower than 4'0(121cm) or higher than 6'3(190cm).
You ARE allowed to alter your height, as long as you stay within that range, and *don't change height mid run*.
- No game breaking glitches are allowed. (glitches that are likely to be patched in the near future, or glitches that rely on server or connection issues.
- In game audio is required to help us detect any splicing or fowl play during a run.
- Bandi Cam (ONLY for *SCREEN MODE*) is allowed for your runs.
- No use of any sort of outside source that is not built within Rec Room may be used in runs. Unless it is a specific category saying so or if it’s a certain system in the rules (like Bandi cam for screen players) than those systems will be allowed.
- Runs must be done on the current version of the game. If any runs are submitted that were during a period where an exploit that no longer exist in the current version was used the run will be rejected. This includes Ramp bug, infinite shot, pinch climbing, water jug glitch (for any questions or explanation on these bugs or glitches contact a moderator or super mod about which one).

categories.name: Golden Trophy
categories.rules:
[big][center]__**Quest for the Golden Trophy**__[/center][/big]

**All runs require video evidence.**
It is **strongly recommended** (*not* required!) that you record a first-person view and don't use the Streamer Cam.
Your video must be **unedited** and contain the original game audio. **Removing game audio will cause your run to be rejected.**
* __Vive/Index:__ Right-click the headset icon in the SteamVR status window, then click *Display Mirror*. Capture the opened window with your preferred recording program.
* __Oculus Rift:__ Believe it or not, Oculus does have a native headset mirror located in *C:\Program Files\Oculus\Support\oculus-diagnostics\OculusMirror.exe*. Capture it but please note that the native aspect ratio is 9:5, so unless you the resize the window it will end up cropped. **We do not recommend using the SteamVR Headset Mirror, as it is a huge performance hog if you're using a Rift.**
* __PSVR:__ Capture Card between headset and console OR Share button (if run is less than 15 min) OR Livestream to Twitch/YouTube and save past livestream. (Thanks DatVoiceGuy for showing PSVR recording options)

**Time is given by the in-game scoreboard.**
The *Previous Results* screen on the scoreboard (can be accessed by clicking *Results*) or at least the scoreboard changing from *Game In Progress* to *Game Over* (since that's technically when the in-game timer stops) **must be shown**.
There are no real-time splits yet. **__Please leave the *Time* field at 00:00 and only fill out the *In-game Time* field.__**
https://i.imgur.com/75HMcsZ.png

**About platforms:**
Platforms don't really matter much since Rec Room is cross platform, but here are the platforms for *the player recording the run*:
- *PC*: HTC Vive (Pro), Valve Index, Oculus __Rift (S)__, Windows MR, etc.
- *PS4*: PSVR
- *Oculus*: Oculus __Quest__
- *iOS*: iOS

values.name: VR
values.rules: **Any players uses VR Mode.**

values.name: Mixed
values.rules:
There must be both a screen player and a VR player.

Runs should start and finish with two players. At no point during the run should anyone join or leave the room.

values.name: Any%
values.rules:
**Anything goes, except using external software and anything that can’t be done on all platforms (ie recalibrate). Just get to the end as fast as possible by any means necessary**

**Bandicam is allowed for screen mode players for any%. It is NOT allowed for VR players since VR players can still watch clip.**

values.name: Glitchless%
values.rules:
No out of bounds (Being outside/traveling through the walls of a map, or the inside a prop/object) the game must be beaten as intended.

Every single wave of enemy should be killed, unless there is an open, clear, and obvious path around spawning it.
(Squeezing through a tight little gap and sticking to the side of the room is not clear and obvious)

No glitching in items

No using unintended bugs (double shot & glitchwalking are acceptable).

values.name: Omega%
values.rules: **Every player MUST touch the end platform before they deal ANY damage. Any% rules apply.**

values.name: Glitchless outdated

No double shot/infinite shot

No quick dashing or double dashing

No double bows (applies only for screen, no swapping between two bows to shoot faster)

No camera strats (using camera to prevent enemies from attacking you)

No extendoing ANYTHING

No throwing weapons out of bounds to refresh or respond them during runs

games.name: Rec Room
games.rules:
**ALL RUNS REQUIRE VIDEO EVIDENCE**
If you remove the video evidence of your run after it has been verified, we reserve the right to remove the run because it no longer meets leaderboard requirements. If this occurs, you will need to resubmit your run to obtain credit.

**ALL POVs AND WORLD SCALE% ARE NEEDED FOR TOP RUNS**

On leaderboards with less than 25 runs, the top 3 runs must show their SteamVR world scale percentage before or after a run (world scale is not allowed and should remain at 100% for ANY run). On leaderboards with 25 runs or more, the requirement is extended to top 5. If there’s a category that has less than 5 runs world scale is not require to be shown. In multiplayer runs, this means that all POVs must be submitted unless the category falls under the less than 5 runs. This only applies to runs done on PCVR after the date of Nov 16th 2023. A bit of an add on but throttling behaviour will also not be allowed for any runs. This only applies for index players but when showing world scale if you scroll down a bit more it'll show throttling behaviour which should not be activated during runs.

Click the results page on the scoreboard to see your final time.
In a co-op run, if different players see different result times on the leaderboard, we will take the lower time.

- No players may leave or join at ANY point during the run for ANY reason
- Joking around during a run and trying to make a run longer than it needs to be is not allowed. A speedrun should be an attempt to go as fast as you can.
- You are not allowed to abuse the size of your playspace to move faster in a run, though you ARE allowed to glitchwalk (leaning and in-game turning). Usually if you take a step here and there (around like once or MAYBE twice in each act) it's fine but if you're constantly walking and you rely on it or are performing a trick that only can be done taking a step or can only be done on large playspaces, thats when it crosses the line.
- Do not use system recalibration during runs.
Examples: OVR Advanced Settings, PSVR recalibration, Quest recalibration, and others of the sort to get through walls or move faster is prohibited.
- Your height cannot be lower than 4'0(121cm) or higher than 6'3(190cm).
You ARE allowed to alter your height, as long as you stay within that range, and *don't change height mid run*.
- No game breaking glitches are allowed. (glitches that are likely to be patched in the near future, or glitches that rely on server or connection issues.
- In game audio is required to help us detect any splicing or fowl play during a run.
- Bandi Cam (ONLY for *SCREEN MODE*) is allowed for your runs.
- No use of any sort of outside source that is not built within Rec Room may be used in runs. Unless it is a specific category saying so or if it’s a certain system in the rules (like Bandi cam for screen players) than those systems will be allowed.
- Runs must be done on the current version of the game. If any runs are submitted that were during a period where an exploit that no longer exist in the current version was used the run will be rejected. This includes Ramp bug, infinite shot, pinch climbing, water jug glitch (for any questions or explanation on these bugs or glitches contact a moderator or super mod about which one).
